thread:
li: quick note — after enabling the new selector for prioritizing SM90 paged-flash on paged workloads we started seeing tail regressions for long-seq, small-batch chat. p99 jumps observed. :frowning:

maria: numbers?

li: model=redwood-open-7b fp16, seq=2048 common, batch=1-3. observed p99 from ~200ms -> ~480ms on some routes. driver=535.86 cuda=12.0 on SM90 nodes.

sam: any kernel-level traces? Triton vs raw CUDA paths?

li: yes — NVTX + kernel catalog showed the problematic path is flash_paged_attn_sm90_v4 (Triton-built). Interestingly, fused_attn_cuda_generic (our raw CUDA path) has much tighter tails.

jordan: v4? we pushed a triton perf patch last week. Could be related. Can you paste a small trace summary?

li: pasted snippet:
```
# sample summary
kernel: flash_paged_attn_sm90_v4    avg=5.1ms p95=9.2ms p99=46.3ms
kernel: fused_attn_cuda_generic     avg=1.9ms p95=2.7ms p99=3.4ms
note: NVTX shows repeated small device memory rebinds during v4 slowdowns
```

maria: hunch: Triton variant's page-table remap/warmup path isn't friendly to fragmented KV caches when batch small. Launch overhead plus page touches cause the long tail.

sam: mitigations?

li: tried two quick mitigations in canary:
1) selector rule: if seq>=1024 && batch<=3 && gpu_arch==sm_90 -> prefer fused_attn_cuda_generic
2) runtime: small prefetch for paged mode on first 6 requests (stage first 128 tokens into contiguous buffer)

deploy-bot: Canary update: selector override applied to sm90-canary-1 and sm90-canary-4. Monitoring metrics stream.

li: canary p99 returned to baseline within 10m. prefetch experiment is promising locally but needs more validation under load.

jordan: let's make the selector rule the default until kernel sleuth finishes. Also open a kernel bug: INF-2401 "triton flash_paged_attn_sm90_v4: intermittent KV rebind tails" and attach NVTX + mempool stats + compile flags.

maria: add synthetic perf job: run seq=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,2,4], kernels=[flash_paged_triton, fused_cuda_generic] across SM80/SM90, cuda 11/12 combos. Collect p50/p95/p99 and page-fault counts.

sam: also add a quick cross-arch compile check: build triton kernels with cuda 11 and cuda 12 and compare PTX to see if there are codegen changes affecting shared memory/banks.

li: will file INF-2401 and link perf dashboard + build artifacts. keeping selector override for 48h to gather more tail traces.

jordan: cc runtime and eng-ml. We'll schedule a kernel sleuth session Tues.

maria: small note — check the Triton runtime config (max_concurrent_launches) and the CUDA driver ABI linking; sometimes the Triton launcher interacts poorly with newer drivers on SM90.

li: added driver/lib checks to the ticket and uploaded nvtx logs. Thanks all.
